source: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth UCC search
source_statement: If you’re seeing this page, it means that your IP address was flagged as a potential security risk by the Secretary of the Commonwealth’s IT Division.
source_listed_possible_reasons: Abnormally high traffic in a short time
cause: Not independently determined; the page lists multiple possible reasons.
action_taken: Stopped all portal requests and canceled planned live batch-driver probes. No retries or alternate transport used to bypass the block.
interpretation: Source access failure is not a zero-result search. Existing completed index queries are preserved; filing histories, collateral attachments, aliases and jurisdiction checks remain incomplete.
privacy_note: Incidental public-client IP and proxy identifiers were omitted from this derivative blocker record.
